id./param/scenario/cs/b_080_cs_190.pack|cs_: "Wh-What is this...!?
"King Carnelian...! Damn you, who are you!
"King Carnelian...!!
"...Oh. Irwin, is that you...? Is everyone... safe?
"Ah, King Carnelian! Thank goodness you're safe...!
"Fortunately, my son, wife, and Jade escaped the castle safely through this ordeal.
"I see... That is good...
"Then I'll send my men after those who escaped at once...!
"King Carnelian, what are you...!?
"Aaaagh...!!
"The Luminary's bloodline ends here...
"King Carnelian! If you're there, answer...! King Carnelian!!
"Oh, King Carnelian!
"Sire! Thank goodness you're safe! I apologize for arriving late!
"King Irwin...! King Carnelian, what happened...!?
"...Irwin suddenly attacked me. I had no choice but to do this myself.
"And my daughter Jade was taken hostage by Dundrasil's queen, Eleanor...!
"What...! Why would the Dundrasil royal family do that...!?
"Presumably the Luminary's birth changed the people of this castle.
"The monsters who attacked aimed to seize the Luminary. Countless lives were lost for that.
"Darkness was drawn to the Luminary's light. Without the Luminary {var:1}, such a tragedy would not have occurred!
"...{var:1} is not a child of hope to save the world. He brings evil darkness to this world...!
"A devil's child who calls disaster...!!
"We cannot leave free a Luminary who threatens Erdrea's peace! Find him, wherever he hides!!
"Yes, sire!
"Ugh... Gh...
"N-No... The Luminary, {var:1}, is not a devil's child...
"I must stop King Carnelian... Or the world will fall into darkness...!
"Eleanor, {var:1}...! Forgive my weakness..."
